text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. You're both up early.
Just what I'd expect from our Ritto Dormitory's rising stars.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. Well, I suppose it's only natural for your nerves to be frayed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Classic season will be ending soon.
Make sure to give it your all so you don't have any regrets, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, now let's all gather around the table
and enjoy a fun breakfast together—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...I'm heading out for morning practice.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...My, my.
Today, we started Daiwa Scarlet's training as usual, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The sky is clear! I'm in perfect condition!
I'm at my absolute best today, too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm going in for one more lap!

"...I can't shake the feeling
that she's constantly hiding something."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Still not back in top shape, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah. Sorry for dropping in so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I was wondering how they're doing.
So I came to ask you, their Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm talking about Scarlett and Vodka.
The air between them has been heavy since this morning.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Both as their dorm head and as their senior... I just really wanted to do something to help those two.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, the pleasure's mine. If there's ever
anything I can do to help, just let me know.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They can become wonderful rivals.
One and only to each other.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To polish each other, neither one of us can be missing.
Nor can either of our running styles.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Running is a mirror that reflects an Umamusume's heart. It is far
too early for either of you to let that brilliance be clouded.

"...And after watching Daiwa Scarlet run for a while,
Fuji Kiseki walked away."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...? Wasn't Fuji over at your place
a moment ago? Did she need something—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …………It doesn't really matter anyway, does it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ever since Vodka and I became roommates,
we've done nothing but fight.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's not like that time was anything special.
If anything, it felt totally normal to me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, it's the usual. Nothing she says
or does has anything to do with me anyway."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm different from her.
If I run the Tiara route, I'll definitely be number one...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, this has nothing to do with you either!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hurry up and get ready to time me!
I know I can get even faster!!

—However, her form that day
was visibly stiff.

"...'Running is a mirror that reflects an Umamusume's heart.'
Those words couldn't be more true."

Should she run the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks) and continue down the Tiara route,
...or should I have her choose the other option?
As her Trainer, what I can do for her is――

"...First, it might be necessary to let her
run straight along her own path."
I decided to proceed with preparations for the Oaks.

"...For her to grow,
she will need time to face her own emotions."

We decided to proceed
with preparations for the Nippon Derby.
